plummer-epistles-john: A. Plummer, The Epistles of S. John, Cambridge Bible for Schools and Colleges (Cambridge University Press), notes on 2 and 3 John (read in the Bible Hub text)
bengel-gnomon-2jn: J. A. Bengel, Gnomon of the New Testament, in English translation, on 2 John 1 (read in the Bible Hub text)
ellicott-johannine: W. M. Sinclair, "The Epistles of St. John," in Charles John Ellicott, ed., A New Testament Commentary for English Readers (1878–1884), introduction and notes on 2 and 3 John (read in the Bible Hub text)
expositors-bible-johannine: The Expositor's Bible, on the Epistles of St. John, chapter on 2 John ("Theology and Life in Kyria's Letter"), read in the Bible Hub text
wiki-2jn-variants: Wikipedia, "Textual variants in the Second Epistle of John" (consulted 2026-10-29): witness lists for 2 John 3, 7, 8, 9, 12 and 13 (a secondary list, not the apparatus itself)
wiki-johannine-mss: Wikipedia, "Papyrus 74", "Codex Sinaiticus", "Codex Vaticanus", "Codex Alexandrinus", "Codex Ephraemi Rescriptus", "Codex Porphyrianus", "Codex Athous Lavrensis" and "Minuscule 1739" (consulted 2026-10-29), on their dates
wiki-ecm: Wikipedia, "Editio Critica Maior" (consulted 2026-10-29): the 28th Nestle-Aland and the fifth UBS edition follow the ECM text in the Catholic Letters
wiki-2john: Wikipedia, "Second Epistle of John" (consulted 2026-10-29), on the readings of "the lady" (Amos Wilder; the NET Bible's note on Athanasius), J. L. Houlden on docetism, and the quotation of Armin Baum (2024) on "the elder"
wiki-3john: Wikipedia, "Third Epistle of John" (consulted 2026-10-29), summarizing C. H. Dodd, Raymond E. Brown, John Painter, Rudolf Schnackenburg, Rudolf Bultmann (as reported by Brown), A. E. Brooke, I. Howard Marshall, David Rensberger and J. A. T. Robinson on authorship, date, Gaius, Diotrephes, Demetrius, the manuscripts and the canon
wiki-muratorian-canon: Wikipedia, "Muratorian fragment" (consulted 2026-10-29), its translation of the line on two letters of John and its canon table, citing the Catechism of the Holy Apostolic Catholic Assyrian Church of the East (2020)
wiki-peshitta-canon: Wikipedia, "Peshitta" (consulted 2026-10-29), on the shorter New Testament of the Peshitta and the Harklean version of 616
grenfell-hunt-poxy-292: B. P. Grenfell and A. S. Hunt, The Oxyrhynchus Papyri, Part II (Egypt Exploration Fund), no. 292: Theon to Tyrannus, a letter of recommendation, about AD 25 (read in the Source Library edition)
cyprian-carthage-256: The Seventh Council of Carthage under Cyprian (AD 256), the judgment of Aurelius of Chullabi, in Ante-Nicene Fathers, vol. 5 (read at newadvent.org)
wiki-antilegomena: Wikipedia, "Antilegomena" (consulted 2026-10-29): on the Peshitta's shorter New Testament and on the Lutheran distinction between homologoumena and antilegomena, which current Lutheran usage extends to 2 Peter, 2 John and 3 John (citing the Lutheran Cyclopedia)
cyprian-letter-73: Cyprian of Carthage, Letter 73, to Pompey, against the letter of Stephen about the baptism of heretics (AD 256), in Ante-Nicene Fathers, vol. 5 (read at newadvent.org)
meyer-commentary-2jn: Meyer's Critical and Exegetical Commentary on the New Testament, in English translation, on 2 John 7 (read in the Bible Hub text)
